codeReview.summary: focusControl is limited to focus + panel.scrollTop adjustment. Client border and transform scale are accounted for. It replaces keyboard/typeahead/open/render restoration paths without changing pointer selection, action state, callbacks or lifecycle cleanup. No new global listeners or asynchronous work are introduced. Oversized controls align their top, avoiding an impossible whole-item visibility guarantee.
